blockers.finding: candidate.md cannot be generated because normalized.md references ui_0001, ui_0002, and ui_0003 but the current ui-block mapping does not resolve those placeholders.

The checked raw sources support lump sum/fixed fee as a compensation method, but do not support the article's detailed use rules for stable scope, predictable projects, renovation suitability, demanding clients, or design-build/CM-at-risk exclusions.
The article and linked questions contain numerical heuristics such as 10-20% contingency, 10-20% lower than MDPE, and a 2.2 multiplier example. These were not found in the checked raw SPP sources.

Preserved UI blocks include fee schedule/rate claims unrelated to the narrow lump-sum source excerpt and a malformed KeyValues block. They cannot be carried into a PASS candidate without repair and source support.

linked_question_audit.finding: Question edits were not created because the article contains unsupported lump-sum heuristics and no candidate could be generated.

overall.next_required_action: Resolve UI blocks, narrow the article to raw-source-backed lump-sum claims or add a stronger raw source, and rerun compose/validate/source audit.
